ActorTalk: Oh, Gray Raven Commandant! Did you need to use the elevator? Sorry about this—it's undergoing maintenance right now. I'm afraid you'll have to use the stairs instead until I finish.

That'd be such a huge help! Regulations require that two people be present for maintenance work, but my partner had something come up at the last minute. So, I was getting really worried about how long it'd take to finish these repairs—I don't want to inconvenience everyone for too long, you see.
You helped the maintenance engineer upgrade and renovate the elevator.
There we go! Here, try out the elevator's new features!
